example.sql_A: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref" AS "e", "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist" AS "g", AVG("sentimentandfundamentals"."shortintrt") AS "m1", AVG("sentimentandfundamentals"."optvolrt") AS "m2" FROM "sentimentandfundamentals" AS "sentimentandfundamentals" INNER JOIN "transactionrecord" AS "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref" GROUP BY "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref", "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS "g", AVG("s1"."m1") AS "v" FROM "s1" AS "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT "s1"."e" AS "e", "s1"."g" AS "g", "s1"."m1" AS "m1", "s1"."m2" AS "m2", (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS "m3" FROM "s1" AS "s1" INNER JOIN "s2" AS "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" ORDER BY (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") DESC LIMIT 10
example.sql_B: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref" AS "e", "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist" AS "g", AVG("sentimentandfundamentals"."shortintrt") AS "m1", AVG("sentimentandfundamentals"."optvolrt") AS "m2" FROM "sentimentandfundamentals" AS "sentimentandfundamentals" INNER JOIN "transactionrecord" AS "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref" GROUP BY "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref", "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist"), "s2" AS (SELECT "tr"."ordertypedist" AS "g", AVG("sf"."shortintrt") AS "v" FROM "sentimentandfundamentals" AS "sf" INNER JOIN "transactionrecord" AS "tr" ON "tr"."transreg" = "sf"."transref" GROUP BY "tr"."ordertypedist") SELECT "s1"."e" AS "e", "s1"."g" AS "g", "s1"."m1" AS "m1", "s1"."m2" AS "m2", (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS "m3" FROM "s1" AS "s1" INNER JOIN "s2" AS "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" ORDER BY (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") DESC LIMIT 10
example.decision: Baseline average per order type: average of per-transaction averages, or average over raw snapshot records
example.reading_A: Average of the step-1 group averages (each transaction weighted equally)
example.reading_B: Average of shortintrt over all joined snapshot records per order type

edits.from: SELECT "s1"."g" AS "g", AVG("s1"."m1") AS "v" FROM "s1" AS "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"
edits.to: SELECT "tr"."ordertypedist" AS "g", AVG("sf"."shortintrt") AS "v" FROM "sentimentandfundamentals" AS "sf" INNER JOIN "transactionrecord" AS "tr" ON "tr"."transreg" = "sf"."transref" GROUP BY "tr"."ordertypedist"

plan_shared.requirement: Inner-join transactionrecord on transreg = transref, compared as text. Unmatched rows are dropped.
Group by transref and ordertypedist. Per group, compute avg(shortintrt) and avg(optvolrt), ignoring missing values.
Average short interest days to cover for the transaction, unrounded.
Average option volume ratio for the transaction, unrounded.
The transaction's average short interest divided by the baseline for its order type mix, unrounded.
Order by the ratio, descending, with missing values last.

choice_A.requirement: The baseline is the average of the per-transaction short-interest averages within the order type mix, so each transaction counts once.

choice_B.requirement: The baseline is the average shortintrt over all matched sentiment snapshot records within the order type mix, so each snapshot counts once.

example.precise_A: For each transaction with sentiment snapshots (match `sentimentandfundamentals.transref` to `transactionrecord.transreg`, dropping unmatched records), together with its order type mix (`ordertypedist`), compute the average short interest days to cover (`shortintrt`) and the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`) across its snapshots, ignoring missing values. Compare each transaction's average short interest with a baseline for its order type mix, computed as the average of the per-transaction short-interest averages within that mix (each transaction counted once). List the transaction reference, order type mix, average short interest, average option volume ratio, and the ratio of the transaction's average short interest to that baseline. Do not round. Sort by the ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and show the top 10.
example.precise_B: For each transaction with sentiment snapshots (match `sentimentandfundamentals.transref` to `transactionrecord.transreg`, dropping unmatched records), together with its order type mix (`ordertypedist`), compute the average short interest days to cover (`shortintrt`) and the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`) across its snapshots, ignoring missing values. Compare each transaction's average short interest with a baseline for its order type mix, computed as the average `shortintrt` over all matched sentiment snapshots within that mix (each snapshot counted once). List the transaction reference, order type mix, average short interest, average option volume ratio, and the ratio of the transaction's average short interest to that baseline. Do not round. Sort by the ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and show the top 10.
example.open: For each transaction that has sentiment data (matching `transref` to `transactionrecord.transreg`, dropping anything unmatched), along with its order type mix, show the transaction reference, the order type mix, its average short interest days to cover and average option volume ratio (ignoring missing values), and how its average short interest compares with the average short interest for its order type mix, as a ratio. Do not round. List the 10 highest ratios first, with missing ratios last.

favouring_phrases.phrase: average of the per-transaction short-interest averages ... (each transaction counted once)
favouring_phrases.handling: OPEN says only 'the average short interest for its order type mix'.
